text_to_image_prompt:
Create ONE single full-body image. 2:3 portrait canvas, head-to-toe uncut, complete hair and shoes, 6% margin top and bottom. Strict straight-on FRONT view, head upright face symmetrical, shoulders and hips level, relaxed arms at sides hands visible, feet slightly apart on same baseline. Long lens neutral undistorted straight camera, no perspective foreshortening. Character-specific body: 187 cm, narrow elegant lean frame. Approximately 8.0 to 8.2 anatomical heads tall from skull crown (exclude tall hair, crown, ears and hat) to soles. Long elegant legs and arms, natural normal neck, proportionate head; do not fake height with heels, tiny shrunken head, stretched neck or camera distortion. Different characters retain distinctive builds. Full outfit: Knee-length black wool overcoat, dark charcoal long wool trousers, black Chelsea boots, same thick scarf.
Premium semi-realistic dimensional 3D character CG: finely sculpted face, delicate luminous skin microtexture, soft subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, individual wispy hair strands, detailed fabric and metal. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with balanced fill, subtle contact shadow. No text, labels, watermark, frame or collage borders. Preserve original age, facial anatomy, ethnicity, hair, eyes and accessories.
Character design: Male age 29. Dark espresso layered hair with an uneven side sweep and light flyaways. Hazel-gray deep-set eyes, long oval face, subtle cleft rounded chin, high narrow cheekbones, slightly convex nose bridge, softly thin lips and low arched brows. Ivory beige skin. Black wool overcoat with a voluminous charcoal woven scarf wrapped neatly below the chin. Quiet thoughtful expression.
reproduction_note: 此为带身份参考图生成的补充素材；独立文字提示词已重建，未经纯文生图复现验证。严格同脸请同时使用身份母版。
